# Overview & Oblast-Keyed Gazetteer Methodology

This supplementary settlement gazetteer documents annual resident population trajectories (2021AD, 2022AD, 2023AD, 2024AD, 2025AD, and 2026AD) for 245 individual cities, frontline towns, regional administrative and territorial defence seats, military garrison towns, hydrocarbon boomtowns, and defence-industrial centres across all 123 Oblast, Occupation-History, and Federal-Subject divisions of Ukraine (33 divisions across all 27 modern Oblasts, Special Cities, and AR Crimea, split strictly by 2014AD and 2022-2026AD occupation history), Belarus (7 Oblasts and Minsk City), and the Russian Federation (83 Oblasts, Krais, Republics, Autonomous Okrugs, Autonomous Oblast, and Federal Cities) [@libanova2024demographic; @iom2025returns; @belstat2024chislennost; @rosstat2024demografiya; @mediazona2025casualties].

Every settlement entry records verified geographic coordinates, historical and alternative names, sovereign country attribution, and positive integer headcounts across every benchmark year, cross-checked against raion conflict intensity, frontline control polygons, Copernicus Sentinel-1 radar and UNOSAT optical damage assessments, and municipal internal displacement registers [@acled2025ukraine; @deepstate2025map; @scher2023sar; @unosat2023mariupol]. Every single one of the 123 Oblast, Occupation-History, and Federal-Subject divisions is represented by at least its administrative seat plus major frontline or industrial towns (0 uncovered Oblasts or Republics).

```{r gazetteer-load, include=FALSE}
map_df <- jsonlite::fromJSON("../../_shared/_gis_cache/invasion_settlement_oblast_map.json")

fmt_int <- function (v) formatC(as.integer(round(as.numeric(v))), format = "d", big.mark = " ")
fmt_pct <- function (p21, p26) {
  ch <- (as.numeric(p26) - as.numeric(p21)) / as.numeric(p21) * 100
  gsub(".", ",", sprintf("%+.1f%%", ch), fixed = TRUE)
}

build_country_gaz_df <- function (cn) {
  sub_m <- map_df[map_df$country == cn, , drop = FALSE]
  sub_m <- sub_m[order(sub_m$obl_idx, -sub_m$p2021), , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    Settlement = sub_m$name,
    Oblast = paste0(sub_m$oblast_name, " (", sub_m$iso, ")"),
    Coords = gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2fN, %.2fE", sub_m$lat, sub_m$lon)),
    P2021 = vapply(sub_m$p2021, fmt_int, character(1)),
    P2022 = vapply(sub_m$p2022, fmt_int, character(1)),
    P2024 = vapply(sub_m$p2024, fmt_int, character(1)),
    P2026 = vapply(sub_m$p2026, fmt_int, character(1)),
    Change = mapply(fmt_pct, sub_m$p2021, sub_m$p2026),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r tab-gaz-summary, echo=FALSE}
sum_rows <- lapply(c("Ukraine", "Belarus", "Russia"), function (cn) {
  sub_m <- map_df[map_df$country == cn, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    Country = cn,
    Admin1Units = as.character(length(unique(sub_m$iso))),
    Settlements = as.character(nrow(sub_m)),
    Urban2021 = fmt_int(sum(sub_m$p2021)),
    Urban2026 = fmt_int(sum(sub_m$p2026)),
    Change = fmt_pct(sum(sub_m$p2021), sum(sub_m$p2026)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_sum <- rbind(do.call(rbind, sum_rows), data.frame(
  Country = "Total Domain",
  Admin1Units = "123",
  Settlements = as.character(nrow(map_df)),
  Urban2021 = fmt_int(sum(map_df$p2021)),
  Urban2026 = fmt_int(sum(map_df$p2026)),
  Change = fmt_pct(sum(map_df$p2021), sum(map_df$p2026)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
))
render_table_template(
  df_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Summary of the 245 tracked urban and frontline settlements across all 123 oblast, occupation-history, and federal-subject divisions (2021AD - 2026AD).",
    col_names = c("Country", "Divisions", "Settlements", "2021AD Sum", "2026AD Sum", "2021-2026AD"),
    label = "tab:gaz-summary"
  )
)
```

# Ukraine: Settlements by Modern Oblast & Occupation Zone (33 Divisions Across 27 Oblasts)

```{r tab-gaz-ua, echo=FALSE}
render_table_template(
  build_country_gaz_df("Ukraine"),
  list(
    caption = "Georeferenced settlement directory and resident population trajectories across all thirty-three Ukrainian oblast and occupation divisions (2021AD - 2026AD).",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Ukrainian Oblast & Occupation Zone (ISO)", "Coords", "2021AD", "2022AD", "2024AD", "2026AD", "Change"),
    label = "tab:gaz-ua"
  )
)
```
